poll.notes: RV sample of the Marist Maine poll whose LV row (49/47) is already in polls.csv; the RV row was not recorded then. Other <1 recorded 0; No response <1 not folded in. First-choice question in a ranked-choice race; round FIRST as with the LV row. RV MoE +/-4.1.

pollster.weighting_quote: To ensure representativeness, data was balanced to match current estimates for registered voters by age, gender, income, and race/ethnicity using L2 voter parameters. Education was balanced to match current CPS estimates for registered voters. Region was adjusted for turnout in similar elections. A likely voter weight was applied to registered voters based on each respondent's estimated probability of voting in the November 2026 election.
